Supporting Information of the paper already extracted as sanchez_2018_ccs-us-biorefineries_pnas (same source-id). Locators are the SI page numbers printed as "n of 5". The to-get row wanted the capture and compression cost method (capex and kWh/t CO2 for fermenter_ccs-concentrated / compressor_co2-dehydration): the SI does NOT print it - it only cites McCollum and Ogden (2006) and says the largest compressor is a 3.8 MW unit. What is new and loaded: Table S1 pipeline capital cost per km and maximum flow for 10 nominal pipe sizes (pipeline_co2, 2014 USD stated), and the storage assumptions (1 Mt/y per well, 0.19 USD/t MVL, 52 M USD per site, 10% and 20 y). Other-values: compressor size, LCFS carbon-intensity figures, global fermentation CO2. Not loaded: optimization model formulation, Figs S1-S2 (charts).
